exercises.title: Event Sourcing Store
exercises.description: Implement a simplified event sourcing architecture for state reconstruction.
exercises.context: Event sourcing is used in financial systems, audit-heavy platforms, and scalable enterprise applications.
technicalNotes: Event sourcing stores state changes as immutable events.
State can be reconstructed from event history.

exercises.title: Query Optimization Engine
exercises.description: Build a simplified query optimizer for filtering large datasets.
exercises.context: Query optimizers improve performance in databases, analytics engines, and search platforms.

exercises.title: Memory Usage Profiler
exercises.description: Track and analyze memory allocation patterns during execution.
exercises.context: Profilers are used in performance engineering, debugging tools, and enterprise systems.

exercises.title: Mini GraphQL Resolver Engine
exercises.description: Implement a lightweight GraphQL-style resolver execution system.
exercises.context: GraphQL engines power APIs, dashboards, and modern frontend-backend integrations.

exercises.title: Dynamic Concurrency Controller
exercises.description: Control concurrent async operations dynamically under heavy workloads.
exercises.context: Concurrency controllers are critical in scalable APIs, upload systems, and distributed services.
technicalNotes: Performance systems depend on balanced execution.

exercises.title: Sandboxed Plugin Runtime
exercises.description: Execute external plugins safely inside an isolated runtime environment.
exercises.context: Plugin runtimes are used in IDEs, automation platforms, browser extensions, and enterprise systems.

exercises.title: Distributed Task Scheduler
exercises.description: Coordinate scheduled tasks across multiple worker instances.
exercises.context: Distributed schedulers are common in cloud systems, automation platforms, and backend infrastructures.
technicalNotes: Cloud systems rely heavily on scheduling mechanisms.

exercises.title: Search Ranking Algorithm
exercises.description: Implement a ranking system for ordering search results by relevance.
exercises.context: Ranking systems are used in search engines, ecommerce platforms, and recommendation systems.
technicalNotes: Search quality depends on ordering accuracy.
Recommendation systems rely on scoring models.

exercises.title: Database Replication Manager
exercises.description: Simulate replication between primary and replica database nodes.
exercises.context: Replication systems improve scalability, redundancy, and reliability in databases.
technicalNotes: Distributed databases rely on replication strategies.

exercises.title: Observability Metrics Pipeline
exercises.description: Aggregate logs, metrics, and traces into a centralized observability pipeline.
exercises.context: Observability systems are critical in cloud-native platforms and large-scale infrastructures.
technicalNotes: Observability combines logs, metrics, and traces.

exercises.title: Finite State Machine Engine
exercises.description: Create a reusable finite state machine engine for complex workflows.
exercises.context: State machines are used in authentication flows, game engines, UI workflows, and automation systems.
technicalNotes: Widely used in scalable UI and backend systems.

exercises.title: Content Delivery Network Simulator
exercises.description: Simulate how a CDN caches and serves assets from edge locations.
exercises.context: CDNs are fundamental in modern web performance and global content delivery.
technicalNotes: CDNs cache assets geographically closer to users.

exercises.title: Workflow Task Orchestrator
exercises.description: Coordinate dependent async tasks with execution ordering.
exercises.context: Task orchestration is used in CI/CD systems, cloud workflows, and automation platforms.

exercises.title: Dynamic Schema Validator
exercises.description: Validate complex nested objects using configurable schemas.
exercises.context: Schema validation is essential in APIs, forms, and enterprise backend systems.
technicalNotes: Enterprise APIs depend heavily on schemas.

exercises.title: Worker Cluster Manager
exercises.description: Manage and monitor multiple worker instances in a cluster.
exercises.context: Cluster managers are used in Node.js servers, cloud systems, and scalable backend infrastructures.
technicalNotes: Clusters improve scalability and fault tolerance.

exercises.title: Distributed Transaction Coordinator
exercises.description: Coordinate transactions between multiple independent services using a two-phase commit strategy.
exercises.context: Distributed transactions are critical in banking systems, ecommerce platforms, and enterprise architectures.
technicalNotes: Distributed transactions synchronize operations across services.
Enterprise systems rely on transactional integrity.

exercises.title: Runtime Expression Compiler
exercises.description: Compile and execute dynamic expressions at runtime safely.
exercises.context: Runtime compilers are used in template engines, automation systems, and low-code platforms.

exercises.title: Role-Based Access Control Engine
exercises.description: Implement a RBAC system with permissions and role inheritance.
exercises.context: RBAC systems secure enterprise dashboards, admin panels, and cloud platforms.
technicalNotes: Enterprise systems depend on secure access control.

exercises.title: API Versioning Router
exercises.description: Route incoming requests dynamically based on API version.
exercises.context: Versioning strategies are fundamental in scalable public APIs and SaaS platforms.
technicalNotes: Large APIs evolve through controlled versioning.

exercises.title: Collaborative Document Engine
exercises.description: Build the core synchronization logic behind collaborative editing systems.
exercises.context: Collaborative editing powers realtime productivity apps like shared code editors and documents.

exercises.title: Singleton Pattern Implementation
exercises.description: Implement the Singleton pattern for creating a single instance across the application.
exercises.context: Singletons are used for configuration managers, connection pools, and global state management in large applications.
technicalNotes: Lazy initialization defers creation until needed.

exercises.title: Decorator Pattern
exercises.description: Implement the Decorator pattern for adding behavior to objects dynamically.
exercises.context: Decorators are used in React higher-order components, middleware patterns, and feature extensions.
technicalNotes: Adds behavior without modifying original class.

exercises.title: Graph with Adjacency List
exercises.description: Implement a graph data structure using adjacency list representation with BFS and DFS.
exercises.context: Graphs model social networks, road maps, web page links, and dependency relationships in software.
technicalNotes: Adjacency list is memory efficient for sparse graphs.
BFS uses queue, DFS uses recursion/stack.

exercises.title: Trie Data Structure
exercises.description: Implement a Trie for efficient prefix-based string operations and autocomplete.
exercises.context: Tries are used in search engines, autocomplete systems, spell checkers, and IP routing.
technicalNotes: Time complexity O(m) where m is word length.

exercises.title: Dijkstra's Shortest Path
exercises.description: Implement Dijkstra's algorithm for finding shortest paths in weighted graphs.
exercises.context: Dijkstra is used in GPS navigation, network routing, flight scheduling, and game pathfinding.
technicalNotes: Time complexity O((V + E) log V) with priority queue.
Can be optimized with Fibonacci heap.

exercises.title: Topological Sort
exercises.description: Implement topological sorting for directed acyclic graphs (DAGs).
exercises.context: Topological sort is used in build systems, task scheduling, dependency resolution, and course planning.

exercises.title: Redux-like State Management
exercises.description: Implement a Redux-like state management system with actions, reducers, and store.
exercises.context: Redux pattern is fundamental in React applications, Vuex, NgRx, and centralized state management.
technicalNotes: Single source of truth for state.
State is read-only, changes via actions.

exercises.title: Observer Pattern with Subjects
exercises.description: Implement the Observer pattern for reactive state changes and event handling.
exercises.context: Observer pattern is used in event systems, reactive frameworks, and pub/sub messaging architectures.
technicalNotes: Observers are notified of state changes.
